page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 architecture server features 24 vCPUs (12 physical cores with hyper-threading) operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, translating to a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including AVX512F and AVX512_VNNI) and AES cryptography.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the average performance tier. It achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. In memory performance, the server registers a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1282.13 GB/sec, alongside an uncached large block read bandwidth of 109.43 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 48.03 GB/sec. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1287.0 and a multi-core score of 9875.0, with notable performance in software compilation (19039.0) and ray tracing (18402.0).

The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions, and lacks a bundled GPU. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. For application workloads, it demonstrates a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec and handles 22.14 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Small-scale LLM inference using a 135M model runs at 78.25 tokens/sec for text generation, while a medium 7B model processes prompts at 34.44 tokens/sec. These characteristics make the server suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, database operations, and moderate computational tasks.
